## [2.0.0](https://github.com/variablenine/morphe-patches/compare/v1.4.12...v2.0.0) (2026-11-12)

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* This bundle no longer contains the official Morphe patches. Keep the official Morphe source in Morphe Manager and add this one next to it.

### refactor

* Retire the fork of the official patches ([fd66aac](https://github.com/variablenine/morphe-patches/commit/fd66aacf93fe046d028e766d2e2e316c61311028))

### ✨ New Features

* **Reddit - Duet reminders:** Keep Claude Duet reminders in view until they are done ([f403002](https://github.com/variablenine/morphe-patches/commit/f4030026a1d31fc7d330978289624c0b371cd421))
* **YouTube - Duet reminders:** Keep Claude Duet reminders in view until they are done ([5554d3f](https://github.com/variablenine/morphe-patches/commit/5554d3f0f796995f8a39cbe457eb36245c8531cc))

patches.name: Duet reminders
patches.description: Keeps reminders from Claude Duet in a small tab at the edge of the screen until you mark them done. Meant to be used together with the official Morphe patches. Needs notification access, which the app asks for the first time it is opened. Does not work with root mount installs.
